test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.

Social justice has been one of the __cherished__ goals of the makers of our Constitution.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e. **'despised'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined word** "cherished"** means to hold or treat as dear; feel love for. (प्रिय). 
 
• The correct antonym **"despised" **means to feel contempt or a deep repugnance for. (घृणा).

Therefore, the** correct answer** is-** 'despised'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Relished' **means to enjoy greatly. Its Hindi meaning is "Anand Lena" (आनंद लेना).
 
• **'Valued'** means to estimate the monetary worth of something. Its Hindi meaning is "Mulyankan Karna" (मूल्यांकन करना).
 
• **'Treasured' **means to keep carefully. Its Hindi meaning is "Sambhalna" (संभालना).
